protocol.quantity: Region-overlapping usable read-2 alignments per million total usable read-2 alignments
protocol.strand: Same alignment and gene strand, consistent with original eCLIP peak counting
protocol.read_policy: Retain paired read 2; accept unpaired records from submitted alignment files; skip read 1, unmapped, secondary, supplementary, duplicate, QC-fail and NH>1 alignments
protocol.overlap: At least one M/= /X CIGAR alignment block overlaps a region; count each alignment once per region; intron skips do not count
protocol.normalization: 1e6 * regional usable read count / all-library usable read count with identical filters
protocol.replicate_aggregation: Normalize each biological replicate separately, then average repeats equally
protocol.factor_aggregation: Average both regions and all 181 genes equally, retaining zero counts
protocol.original_IG: Reuse frozen mean absolute IG_S from 181 held-out genes and five seeds; no model retraining or IG recomputation
protocol.controls: IP abundance only, following previous ChIP CPM; no size-matched input subtraction
protocol.data_policy: Stream each complete BAM without retaining it; verify byte length and ENCODE MD5 before accepting counts
